name: Plan generation, critique, compilation, and approval
userOutcome: The user can receive independent planning proposals, critique, synthesis, compiler diagnostics, and an approval decision.
productionDataSource: Planning request, project context, role/model configuration, agent outputs, and compiler results.
errorBehavior: Preserve completed proposals and diagnostics, stop within budgets, and allow targeted repair without activating an incomplete plan.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not reveal a planner answer before required independent responses finish.
Do not activate a plan that fails compilation.
Do not treat model consensus as human approval.
acceptanceTests: Run at least two planners concurrently.
Reject a cycle or missing verification.
